Solution A is correct and Solution B is not.

The equation $|x-4| - 10 = 2$ simplifies to $|x-4| = 12$, so $x - 4 = 12$ or $x - 4 = -12$. That gives $x = 16$ or $x = -8$. Their product is $16 \times (-8) = -128$.

Solution A follows this path. In its second case it writes $-(x-4) = 12$, so $x - 4 = -12$ and $x = -8$, which is correct.

Solution B makes an error in its second case. It writes $-(x-4) - 10 = 2$, which correctly gives $-(x-4) = 12$, but then it states $x - 4 = -8$. The right value is $x - 4 = -12$. This leads to the wrong root $x = -4$, and the final product $-64$ is wrong.

Checking both roots in the original equation confirms the answer. For $x = 16$: $|12| - 10 = 2$. For $x = -8$: $|-12| - 10 = 2$. Both work, and $x = -4$ does not: $|-8| - 10 = -2 \neq 2$.

WINNER: A
